app.title: Turant
app.tagline: Emergency help for your bank account — in your language.
app.disclaimer: Turant never sends anything by itself. You always press Send or Call.
app.safetyBanner: Turant never calls you and never asks for OTP, PIN or CVV.
status.noData: Bank data is not loaded yet
status.noDataDetail: Official phone numbers and block commands will appear here once they are added to data/actions.json from the bank's own official source.
bank.empty: No actions recorded for this bank yet.
action.checkLine: Check this number matches the bank's page.
voice.errNotAllowed: Allow microphone access in your browser settings
voice.errNetwork: Voice needs Google Chrome and an internet connection
voice.errNoSpeech: I didn't hear anything, tap and speak again
voice.errLanguage: Voice is not available in this language on this browser, please tap instead
voice.needsHttps: Voice works on the https version of Turant
voice.unsupported: Voice is not available on this browser. Please tap instead.
voice.privacy: Your browser sends your voice to its own speech service (Google, in Chrome) to turn it into text. Turant does not receive or save it. Do not say your card number, PIN or OTP.
complaint.title: Write a complaint
complaint.safety: Turant never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or your full account number.
complaint.intro: Fill this in and Turant writes a letter to your branch in English. Nothing is saved, and nothing is sent unless you send it.
complaint.name: Full name
complaint.ifscHint: Printed in your passbook or cheque book. Turant uses it to look up the branch address online.
complaint.ifscFailed: Could not find this branch. Type the branch name and address below.
complaint.ifscInvalid: An IFSC has 11 characters: 4 letters, then 0, then 6 letters or numbers.
complaint.last4: Last 4 digits of card or account
complaint.branchEmailHint: Paste your branch’s email address if you have it.
complaint.ownWordsHint: Write or speak in your own language. It goes into the letter exactly as written.
complaint.emailInvalid: This does not look like an email address.
complaint.fixErrors: Please check the fields marked below.
letter.title: Your complaint letter
letter.printTip: Print 2 copies. Give one to the branch and get the other stamped as proof.
letter.emailNote: For your safety, the email leaves the card digits blank. Type the last 4 digits in your mail app before you press Send.
letter.noBranch: Add the branch name and address on the form to see directions.
